name: Nintendo Entertainment System / Famicom

cpu.notes: 6502 core with the decimal mode disabled, plus the APU and OAM DMA on the same die

regions.name: Cartridge PRG ROM
regions.notes: 8000-FFFF: program ROM, banked by the mapper; vectors at FFFA-FFFF

native.note: NTSC TVs commonly crop the top and bottom 8 lines

modes.name: Background + sprites
modes.notes: 8x8 tiles from CHR memory (8 KB pattern tables), 64 sprites with 8 per scanline, 4 background and 4 sprite palettes of 3 colours plus a shared backdrop

palette.note: master palette of 64 entries chosen from a 32-byte palette RAM; the exact RGB values are analogue and differ between decoders

audio.notes: two pulse channels, one triangle, one noise, one delta-modulation (DMC) sample channel

charset.name: none (tile based)
charset.note: no fixed character set; text is drawn from tiles in the cartridge CHR data

keyboard.notes: serial shift-register read at $4016/$4017; the Famicom Family BASIC keyboard is an optional peripheral

controllers.notes: Zapper light gun and other devices use the same ports

media.notes: iNES: 16-byte header starting 4E 45 53 1A, then PRG and CHR ROM; NES 2.0 extends it

roms.note: games are cartridge images supplied by the user; mapper numbers (0 NROM, 1 MMC1, 2 UxROM, 3 CNROM, 4 MMC3 ...) are in the iNES header

testMaterial: Candidates to confirm per licence: nestest, blargg's NES test ROMs, homebrew released with redistribution terms
